anti_slop.notes: Пастиша и клише нет, чувства показаны телом, а не ярлыком.

aggregate.rule: mean(6)>=80 (PROVISIONAL: calibration likely adds a per-axis floor)

summary.rule: pass = aggregate.pass && deterministic hard gate && no error; passRate = passCount / scored (errored excluded, re-run); suitePass = passRate >= 0.8 (PROVISIONAL)
